lsblk -J -b -p -o NAME,KNAME,TYPE,SIZE,MODEL,VENDOR,TRAN,RM,HOTPLUG,RO,SERIAL,WWN,MOUNTPOINTS
lsblk -rno PKNAME $ROOT/dev/fakemed3
sfdisk --json /dev/fakemed
wipefs --all --force /dev/fake1
udevadm settle
systemd-repart --dry-run=no --definitions=$ROOT/run/fishermand/install-$N/repart.d --empty=force --key-file=$ROOT/run/fishermand/luks-transient/pending-install-$N --pretty=no --json=short --no-pager /dev/fake1
udevadm settle
cryptsetup luksUUID /dev/fake1p4
cryptsetup open --type luks2 --key-file=- /dev/fake1p4 $MAPPER <stdin 21 bytes>
blkid -p -s TYPE -o value /dev/fake1p2
blkid -p -s UUID -o value /dev/fake1p2
udevadm settle
blkid -p -s UUID -o value /dev/fake1p2
blkid -p -s TYPE -o value /dev/fake1p3
blkid -p -s UUID -o value /dev/fake1p3
e2fsck -fy /dev/fake1p3
tune2fs -U random /dev/fake1p3
udevadm settle
blkid -p -s UUID -o value /dev/fake1p3
blkid -p -s TYPE -o value /dev/mapper/$MAPPER
blkid -p -s UUID -o value /dev/mapper/$MAPPER
btrfs inspect-internal dump-super /dev/mapper/$MAPPER
btrfstune -f -S 0 /dev/mapper/$MAPPER
btrfstune -f -u /dev/mapper/$MAPPER
udevadm settle
blkid -p -s UUID -o value /dev/mapper/$MAPPER
mount /dev/mapper/$MAPPER $ROOT/run/fishermand/install-$N/mnt/root
mount /dev/fake1p3 $ROOT/run/fishermand/install-$N/mnt/boot
mount /dev/fake1p2 $ROOT/run/fishermand/install-$N/mnt/efi
sync
systemd-firstboot --root=$ROOT/run/fishermand/install-$N/mnt/root/ostree/deploy/default/deploy/abc.0 --force --locale=en_GB.UTF-8 --keymap=gb --timezone=Europe/London --hostname=ada-box
useradd --root $ROOT/run/fishermand/install-$N/mnt/root/ostree/deploy/default/deploy/abc.0 --no-create-home --home-dir /home/ada --shell /bin/bash --comment Ada Lovelace --groups wheel ada
btrfs filesystem resize max $ROOT/run/fishermand/install-$N/mnt/root
efibootmgr --create --disk /dev/fake1 --part 2 --label Bonito --loader \EFI\fedora\shimx64.efi
sync
umount -R $ROOT/run/fishermand/install-$N/mnt/efi
umount -R $ROOT/run/fishermand/install-$N/mnt/boot
umount -R $ROOT/run/fishermand/install-$N/mnt/root
cryptsetup close $MAPPER
cryptsetup open --test-passphrase --key-file=$ROOT/run/fishermand/empty-key-$N --disable-external-tokens --token-type=fisherman-keyslots-only /dev/fake1p4
crypt: cryptsetup luksDump /dev/fake1p4
crypt: cryptsetup luksUUID /dev/fake1p4
crypt: cryptsetup luksDump /dev/fake1p4
crypt: systemd-cryptenroll --wipe-slot=0 --password /dev/fake1p4 <new secret 21 bytes> <unlock secret 64 bytes>
crypt: cryptsetup luksDump /dev/fake1p4
